description:
I’m not sure how many times I said “I’m scared” in this video, but apparently it was enough that my 9-year-old finally hit me with:

“Your job is to believe in yourself.”

Well. Okay then. 😂

Here’s what I’m learning about doing new things in your 40s:

→You don’t have to stop being scared.
→ You don’t have to look cool.
→ You don’t have to be naturally good at it.
→ You just have to be willing to be a beginner.

To wobble.
To look ridiculous.
To have a few battle wounds.
To say I’m scared and go anyway.

I spent a lot of my younger years thinking confidence meant feeling ready. 

Or not being scared.

At 43, I know better.

Confidence is BEING SCARED and deciding to believe in yourself anyway.

And sometimes you just need your 9-year-old to remind you. 🛹❤️

#skategirl #surfskate #surfskatebeginner #pumptrack #confidencetips
